# Evaluation: ham10000-vit-q8-25be9e61

*Generated by `ai-service/scripts/evaluate-cancer-models.py` on 2026-11-16.*

**Data:** ISIC 2018 Task 3 (HAM10000 challenge; CC BY-NC 4.0, attribution: ISIC Archive, Tschandl et al. 2018, Codella et al. 2019): official validation set (193 images) for calibration and official test set (1,512 images) for metrics. The model was fine-tuned on HAM10000, i.e. the challenge training set; the validation and test images were released separately.

Calibration split: 193 images. Test split: 1512 images (1512 groups).

Cancer classes in the binary view: melanoma, basal_cell_carcinoma, actinic_keratoses. Intervals: Wilson score for proportions, stratified-free bootstrap (2,000 resamples) for AUC.
